## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete trigger and what changes for the user.

## Validation

Commands actually run, synthetic fixture/native evidence and checks not run.
For Git writes: describe preservation of working/index contents, stale review,
failure behavior and recovery. For AI: distinguish offline tests from authorized
live inference. For installers: state architecture and signing/launch evidence.

## Maintainer handoff

Update CHANGELOG.md and STATUS.md as appropriate. Include known limits and the
next reviewable task. Do not attach private data or claim publication from a build.
